name: crios
description: Work with Crios projects, build sessions, workflows, and connectors from Cursor.

CRIOS_BASE_URL.title: Crios base URL
CRIOS_BASE_URL.description: App or API origin. Defaults to https://crios.ai. The plugin calls /api/v1 on that origin. Set this to point at another instance. Do not include a token in the URL.

CRIOS_TOKEN.title: Crios personal access token
CRIOS_TOKEN.description: Personal access token from Crios Settings → API tokens. Set it here in Plugins → Configure. It starts with crios_pat_. A full-access token is required for workflows.
